rows.label: qev018901_MSG0001
rows.name:
Sigh... I'm happy, but something's
bothering me... What's wrong with
Mee-mee?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0002
rows.name:
...Say, gold member... Can I ask you for
some advice?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0003
rows.name:
Gold member, do you have anything more
precious than money?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0010
rows.name: Affirmative

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0011
rows.name: Say there are many things more important than money.

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0020
rows.name: Negative

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0021
rows.name: State firmly that there is nothing more important than money in this world.

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0004
rows.name:
Comrades? Dreams? Humanity's future? You
like rather vague things, don't you?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0005
rows.name:
When you have things like that, does
money stop mattering to you?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0006
rows.name:
Mee-mee found something precious... Ever
since discovering that round food called
pizza, money hasn't mattered.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0007
rows.name:
Right. Nothing else gives Mee-mee's
super alchemy machine a score as clearly
as money does...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0008
rows.name:
But since I discovered that great...
round food called pizza, I've lost
interest in money.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0009
rows.name:
One bite of pizza fills me with more
happiness than earning hundreds of
millions![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0010
rows.name:
If I have enough money to buy pizza, I
can be happy for the rest of my life...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0011
rows.name:
So working away without time to eat
pizza seems awfully silly...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0030
rows.name: Proposal

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0031
rows.name: Suggest that she take a break for a while.

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0040
rows.name: Scold

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0041
rows.name: Get angry and tell her to think of the people who need Mee-mee.

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0012
rows.name:
Somehow, I feel like I've been waiting
for you to say that for a long time...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0013
rows.name:
Thank you, gold member. Mee-mee's made
up her mind![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0014
rows.name:
Right... Mee-mee earns all that money
because people need her super alchemy
machines...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0015
rows.name:
Thank you, gold member. Mee-mee had
forgotten something important![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0016
rows.name:
I'll automate and revamp my super
alchemy machines so they'll be fine even
when Mee-mee retires![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0017
rows.name:
And then... I'll spend my life eating
pizza here! I'll be happy all day long![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0018
rows.name:
Hey, hey! For that, I'll need 50 pieces
of Aurora Stone...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0019
rows.name:
And 20 pieces of Arc Sand Ore! Could you
bring them to me?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0020
rows.name:
I'll make you the most special of
special members with a special rate... a
platinum member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0021
rows.name: Please? Take Mee-mee to pizza heaven![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0022
rows.name:
Mee-mee will be waiting right here
eating pizza, so be sure to bring them![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0023
rows.name:
Then I'll finish my last big job! I'm
counting on you, please![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0024
rows.name:
Wow! Delicious! Pizza really is a
miracle![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0025
rows.name:
I never felt this happy even when I made
hundreds of millions of G![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0026
rows.name:
I've been eating pizza this whole time!
Hurry and bring what I asked for![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0027
rows.name:
O-oh...! Wow!! This is... the ultimate
in deliciousness![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0028
rows.name:
Have you tried it? My pizza buddy Fefen
told me about this... Grenade Pizza.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0029
rows.name:
It's so, so delicious... My happiness
feels like it's about to explode![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0050
rows.name: Affirmative

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0051
rows.name: Agree with Mee-mee that happiness feels like it's going to explode.

rows.label: qev018901_JNK0060
rows.name: Proposal

rows.label: qev018901_SEL0061
rows.name: Tell her you've brought the requested items.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0030
rows.name:
You're a pizza buddy too! Nothing could
make me happier![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0031
rows.name:
...Oh, right! I have to hurry
and automate the Alchemy Mechs![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0032
rows.name:
Then I can eat pizza without watching
the time and talk pizza with you![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0033
rows.name:
Hey, did you get the things I
asked for? I have to finish up
the troublesome stuff quickly![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0034
rows.name:
Oh dear, oh dear! I'd completely
forgotten![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0035
rows.name:
I've got to upgrade the alchemy machines
fast so I can enjoy pizza time in peace![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0036
rows.name: So, did you get the things I asked for?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0037
rows.name:
Thank you! I'll finish the upgrade right
away![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0038
rows.name:
Then the Shining Erudition Hall will be
fine even when Mee-mee is gone![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0039
rows.name:
Yes... Thank you so much for everything!
I name you our very first platinum
member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0040
rows.name:
Please continue to favor the
Shining Erudition Hall's Miranium
exchange service from now on![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0041
rows.name:
...Hehe! I think Mee-mee will only be
serving you at the counter from now on,
though![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0042
rows.name:
Come to think of it, I left a little
bit for myself and donated the rest
of my fortune to BLADE Headquarters.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0043
rows.name:
Do your best on that front too and keep
this city safe for good![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0044
rows.name: ...Eh? Why did I donate it, you ask?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0045
rows.name:
Because to keep eating pizza,
I need this NLA, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0046
rows.name:
So giving money to you who protect NLA
is the most rational way to use it![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018901_MSG0047
rows.name:
I'm counting on you! Make sure Mee-mee
can keep eating pizza in peace![ST:wait ]
